title: grid account scan output
description: JSON output of grid account scan --json; internal/cli/account.go:112. One entry per provider config folder with its login email. The app decodes kind, dir, home, signedIn, email and plan (agentaccounts http.go:187-194); the account id, name, default, checked and added of its page rows come from its own records, not from this answer.

dir.description: The folder as an absolute path.

signedIn.description: null when the scan could not tell, for example when the provider's program is not installed.

email.description: The login email, or the empty string when the folder has none.

plan.description: The login's plan, or the empty string when unknown.
